BALB/cJ and C57BL/10 are similar in terms of the effects of aging on hearing and the effects of noise exposure on hearing.
BALB/cJ and C57BL/10J mice have different forms of ARHL, and that Ahl is not responsible for all of the ARHL in either strain.
